implementation_findings.result: The new explicit montaigne-entries branch reads the existing data/sae-montaigne.json directly. It checks the aggregate root, ordered slugs and numbering, the Chinese material schema and each section. It retains all 159 body units and 31 headings, five optional asides and the variable note counts 1/1/1/1/1/2. No duplicate Chinese corpus is introduced. The pre-existing numbered-file path for Descartes and Spinoza remains separate.

reference_bundle imports the original build_sae_western.SOURCES and SOURCE_KEYS. Article titles and precise URLs are selected from that actual mapping in its original order, for eighteen mapped references. A separate copied reference table is not used.

The opted-in source_digest protects the full original aggregate JSON bytes, including the original English content, together with a stable sorted-key serialization of both actual source dictionaries. The prefix and explicit byte length separate the original JSON from the reference serialization. All six articles intentionally share this whole-source fingerprint. The current five source tests prove that a raw JSON-byte change, an actual reference URL change, or a reference-order change invalidates it. Existing source-digest branches are not changed.

build_sae_western first produces its original eight outputs. It upgrades only the seven pages whose parent is the Montaigne directory, and only if a real publication receipt exists and require_review_seal succeeds. The parent shelf is not accidentally passed to upgrade_primary. No receipt exists during this audit. A receipt's mere existence is not treated as approval.

The new source tests compare all seven complete primary main-area hashes, the six combined primary reading-body hashes and the complete canonical source hash to the captured baseline. The primary-only control test uses actual existing primary pages, adds the real marked controls in memory, verifies idempotence and exact byte reversibility after removing only those controls, and verifies a CRLF modification is not falsely accepted. It does not render a draft foreign page or fake an approval.

All six methods were read in full and AST-parsed. Their positive paths require actual reviews, a genuine receipt and rendered files; corrupt-input mocks are negative rejection checks only. They cover complete body blocks, optional asides, all notes and historical citation arrays, the two entries, native routes, original primary content, metadata, analytics, local links and discovery. They have not been run for this unsealed series.
